block_bootstrap.what: Resamples blocks (T/4) of the same series with replacement.
block_bootstrap.avoid_when: Inferred from the code: the joins between blocks break continuity.

dba.what: Weighted DTW barycenter average of 4 series of the same class (Dirichlet weights, 20% band).
dba.good_for: Datasets with labels and several series per class.
dba.avoid_when: Pure-Python DTW: slow on long series or many samples (from the code). Without labels it uses a single class.

decomp_bootstrap.what: Moving-average trend + per-phase seasonality (period estimated via ACF) + block-resampled residuals.
decomp_bootstrap.good_for: Series with clear seasonality (period detected if ACF>0.3).
decomp_bootstrap.avoid_when: Without clear seasonality the period is 0 and only trend + residuals remain. It is not statsmodels' STL.

diffusion-ts.what: Diffusion for time series (Diffusion-TS): the repo's model with minimal Adam+EMA training written in the worker.
diffusion-ts.avoid_when: Requires GPU. Does not use the repo's solver.py; data scaled to [-1,1].

fourier_surrogate.what: Randomizes the phases of the Fourier spectrum while keeping the amplitude; same phases on all channels.
fourier_surrogate.avoid_when: Inferred from the code: preserves only the spectrum, loses non-linear structures and localized peaks.

iaaft.what: IAAFT surrogate: preserves spectrum and value distribution (30 iterations, per channel).
iaaft.avoid_when: Correlation between channels is not preserved (from the catalog).

imagentime.what: Turns the series into images and uses EDM diffusion (ImagenTime).
imagentime.avoid_when: Requires GPU (.cuda() in the repo); two missing `data.*` modules replaced by stubs. networks.py from NVIDIA EDM is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial); the repo has no license.
imagentime.source: modalities/ts/catalog_ext.py + modalities/ts/workers/ext_imagentime.py; Naiman et al. NeurIPS 2024

jitter.what: Adds Gaussian noise (5% of the channel std) to existing series.
jitter.avoid_when: Does not create new structures: the series stays almost the same. No GPU requirement.
jitter.source: modalities/ts/workers/classic.py + modalities/ts/catalog_classic.py; Um et al. ICMI 2017

kovae.what: VAE with a Koopman operator (KoVAE); original model, training rewritten from run_regular.py.
kovae.avoid_when: Requires GPU (.cuda() in the repo). The repo has no license: check before redistributing.
kovae.source: modalities/ts/catalog_ext.py + modalities/ts/workers/ext_kovae.py; Naiman et al. ICLR 2024

magnitude_warp.what: Multiplies the series by a smooth curve (4-knot spline, sigma 0.2) around 1.
magnitude_warp.avoid_when: Changes only the amplitude over time.
magnitude_warp.source: modalities/ts/workers/classic.py + modalities/ts/catalog_classic.py; Um et al. ICMI 2017

mixup.what: Convex combination of two series of the same class, lambda ~ Beta(0.4,0.4).
mixup.avoid_when: Without labels it treats everything as one class.
mixup.source: modalities/ts/workers/classic.py + modalities/ts/catalog_classic.py; Zhang et al. ICLR 2018

pca.what: Global PCA (95% variance) on the flattened series, scores perturbed with 0.3*std noise, reconstruction.
pca.good_for: Datasets with series of equal length (global PCA on the flattened series).
pca.avoid_when: Inferred from the code: with few samples the PCA is unreliable.

permutation.what: Shuffles 4 segments of the same series.
permutation.avoid_when: Inferred from the code: breaks the coarse-grained order, unsuitable if the order of the segments carries information.
permutation.source: modalities/ts/workers/classic.py + modalities/ts/catalog_classic.py; Um et al. ICMI 2017

rgan.avoid_when: DESCRIBED ONLY, not runnable: requires TensorFlow 1.x (tf.contrib).

rotation.what: With multiple channels applies a random orthogonal rotation; with one channel it flips (mirror about the mean or time reversal).
rotation.avoid_when: Inferred from the code: with D>1 it mixes the channels, unsuitable if they have distinct physical meanings.
rotation.source: modalities/ts/workers/classic.py + modalities/ts/catalog_classic.py; Um et al. ICMI 2017

scaling.what: Multiplies each channel by a factor ~N(1,0.1).
scaling.avoid_when: Changes only the amplitude, not the temporal shape.
scaling.source: modalities/ts/workers/classic.py + modalities/ts/catalog_classic.py; Um et al. ICMI 2017

sigcwgan.what: Conditional Sig-Wasserstein GAN: autoregressive generation conditioned on the prefix (3 steps) of a real series.
sigcwgan.avoid_when: The prefix is copied from the real series. `signatory` replaced by a torch module written by us. Requires GPU. Repo without a license.

simpsi.what: Spectrum-preserving augmentation (SimPSI); spectral mixing rule rewritten with a magnitude map.
simpsi.avoid_when: Not the original: equalizer not learned, no classifier. Does not require GPU.
simpsi.source: modalities/ts/catalog_ext.py + modalities/ts/workers/ext_simpsi.py; Ryu et al. AAAI 2024

slice_shuffle.what: Recombines 4 segments taken from different series of the same class (CutMix style).
slice_shuffle.good_for: Datasets with class labels: segments are taken from the same class.
slice_shuffle.avoid_when: Without labels it treats everything as a single class.

smote.what: Interpolates a series toward one of the 5 nearest neighbors of the same class.
smote.good_for: Oversampling of minority classes in datasets with labels.
smote.avoid_when: Euclidean distance on the flattened series: not robust to temporal shifts (from the code). Without labels it uses a single class.

ssa.what: Reduced-rank reconstruction (SSA, 95% energy) plus block-resampled residuals.
ssa.avoid_when: The rank is computed on the first channel of the first series and reused for all (code limitation).

time_warp.what: Warps the time axis with a smooth, monotonic speed (sigma 0.3).
time_warp.avoid_when: Inferred from the code, not documented: ruins series with events anchored to precise instants.
time_warp.source: modalities/ts/workers/classic.py + modalities/ts/catalog_classic.py; Um et al. ICMI 2017

timegan-orig.what: TimeGAN, original code by Yoon et al.
timegan-orig.avoid_when: DESCRIBED ONLY, not runnable: requires TensorFlow 1.15 (tf.contrib), incompatible with Python 3.10. Use tsgm-timegan.

timevae.what: timeVAE: VAE with a decoder made of trend/seasonality/residual components.
timevae.avoid_when: Runs on CPU only (TensorFlow 2.16, env ts_tf; no TF-GPU on native Windows): can be slow on large datasets.
timevae.source: modalities/ts/catalog_gen.py + modalities/ts/workers/timevae.py; Algorithms/timeVAE; Desai et al. 2021

timevae-conv.what: Convolutional VAE (baseline of the timeVAE repo), original TensorFlow code.
timevae-conv.avoid_when: Runs on CPU only (TensorFlow 2.16, env ts_tf; no TF-GPU on native Windows): can be slow on large datasets.
timevae-conv.source: modalities/ts/catalog_gen.py + modalities/ts/workers/timevae.py; Algorithms/timeVAE; Desai et al. 2021

timevae-dense.what: Dense VAE (baseline of the timeVAE repo), original TensorFlow code.
timevae-dense.avoid_when: Runs on CPU only (TensorFlow 2.16, env ts_tf; no TF-GPU on native Windows): can be slow on large datasets.
timevae-dense.source: modalities/ts/catalog_gen.py + modalities/ts/workers/timevae.py; Algorithms/timeVAE; Desai et al. 2021

timevqvae.what: VQ-VAE + MaskGIT, original code; conditioned on labels if present. Codebook 256 (repo: 1024).
timevqvae.source: modalities/ts/catalog_ext.py + modalities/ts/workers/ext_timevqvae.py; Lee et al. AISTATS 2023

tsdiff.what: Unconditional diffusion with an S4 backbone (TSDiff, Amazon).
tsdiff.avoid_when: Univariate: one model per channel, correlations between channels not modeled. S4 without pykeops: slow kernel. Requires GPU.
tsdiff.source: modalities/ts/catalog_ext.py + modalities/ts/workers/ext_tsdiff.py; Kollovieh et al. NeurIPS 2023

tsgm-betavae.what: Convolutional beta-VAE from tsgm; generates by sampling the latent space.
tsgm-betavae.avoid_when: Requires GPU. Does not use labels.
tsgm-betavae.source: modalities/ts/catalog_gen.py + modalities/ts/workers/tsgm_gen.py; https://github.com/AlexanderVNikitin/tsgm; Higgins et al. ICLR 2017

tsgm-cbetavae.what: Beta-VAE conditioned on the label (tsgm); the output includes the labels.
tsgm-cbetavae.avoid_when: Error if the .npz has no `labels`. Requires GPU.

tsgm-cgan.what: GAN conditioned on the label (tsgm); the output includes the labels.
tsgm-cgan.avoid_when: Error if the .npz has no `labels`. Requires GPU.

tsgm-ddpm.what: DDPM diffusion model with a convolutional denoiser (tsgm).
tsgm-ddpm.source: modalities/ts/catalog_gen.py + modalities/ts/workers/tsgm_gen.py; https://github.com/AlexanderVNikitin/tsgm; Ho et al. NeurIPS 2020

tsgm-gan.what: Unconditional convolutional GAN from the tsgm library; generates series from scratch.
tsgm-gan.avoid_when: Requires GPU. Does not use labels.

tsgm-timegan.avoid_when: With the torch backend it fails (library bug): it only runs on TensorFlow CPU (env ts_tf), without GPU.
tsgm-timegan.source: modalities/ts/catalog_gen.py + modalities/ts/workers/tsgm_gen.py; https://github.com/AlexanderVNikitin/tsgm; Yoon et al. NeurIPS 2019

tsgm-wavegan.what: WaveGAN from tsgm, a GAN for waveforms.
tsgm-wavegan.avoid_when: Univariate: the worker trains one model per channel (correlations between channels not modeled). Requires GPU.
tsgm-wavegan.source: modalities/ts/catalog_gen.py + modalities/ts/workers/tsgm_gen.py; https://github.com/AlexanderVNikitin/tsgm; Donahue et al. ICLR 2019

uchida-dgw.what: Discriminative guided warping: warping guided by positive and negative prototypes.
uchida-dgw.good_for: Datasets with at least two classes.
uchida-dgw.avoid_when: With a single class there are no negative prototypes and the series stays unchanged.
uchida-dgw.source: modalities/ts/catalog_ext.py + modalities/ts/workers/ext_uchida.py; Algorithms/time_series_augmentation; Iwana & Uchida PLOS ONE 2021

uchida-rgw.what: Random guided warping: warps a series according to the DTW alignment toward a prototype of the same class.
uchida-rgw.avoid_when: Same prototype index error as SPAWNER (in the repo). Does not require GPU.
uchida-rgw.source: modalities/ts/catalog_ext.py + modalities/ts/workers/ext_uchida.py; Algorithms/time_series_augmentation; Iwana & Uchida PLOS ONE 2021

uchida-spawner.what: SPAWNER: DTW average of series of the same class aligned on a common point (original code).
uchida-spawner.avoid_when: Index error in the repo when choosing the prototype. Without labels it uses a single class. Does not require GPU.
uchida-spawner.source: modalities/ts/catalog_ext.py + modalities/ts/workers/ext_uchida.py; Algorithms/time_series_augmentation; Iwana & Uchida PLOS ONE 2021

uchida-wdba.what: Weighted DBA: medoid of 6 series of the class with exponential weights on the DTW distances.
uchida-wdba.avoid_when: Different from the classic `dba` (Dirichlet weights). Does not require GPU.
uchida-wdba.source: modalities/ts/catalog_ext.py + modalities/ts/workers/ext_uchida.py; Algorithms/time_series_augmentation; Iwana & Uchida PLOS ONE 2021

window_slice.what: Crops a 90% window and stretches it back to the original length.
window_slice.avoid_when: With very short series the window is only a few points; the stretching interpolates.
window_slice.source: modalities/ts/workers/classic.py + modalities/ts/catalog_classic.py; Le Guennec et al. 2016

window_warp.what: Compresses (x0.5) or expands (x2) a 10% window and brings the series back to the original length.
window_warp.avoid_when: With very short series the window is minimal.
window_warp.source: modalities/ts/workers/classic.py + modalities/ts/catalog_classic.py; Le Guennec et al. 2016
